attributes.law_screen: claim.law.webfrank-permutation-is-audited-in-our-colouring APPLIED as the adjudicator: instruction counts are equal (88/88), the masked byte scan reports zero offenders, and per that law's screening rule 3 the scan alone is not proof, so verify_consistent_recolor was run as the oracle and passes. claim.law.webfrank-pinned-function-source-freeze and claim.law.webfrank-pin-freezes-its-inlined-helpers-too APPLIED to the pinning decision: the source drive at commit 561994d6 already closed every structural and reload residual in this function, so freezing it forfeits no live axis. claim.law.callee-saved-home-copy-coalescing-is-source-unreachable SCREENED and NOT applicable: that law's signature is a target-only mr leaving us one instruction short, whereas here sizes are equal and no copy is involved. claim.law.constant-copy-vs-rematerialize-is-source-unreachable SCREENED and NOT applicable: both builds emit li rN,0, differing only in N, with no copy-vs-remat asymmetry. claim.law.adding-a-local-renumbers-the-anonymous-pool-and-drifts-siblings NOT applicable (no source edit in atree.c).
attributes.residual: NONE. The function is byte-exact after the rule. Mechanism was a single callee-saved web recolor of the match-index counter: retail colours it r24 and ours r22, across exactly its three sites (li rN,0 at +0xa4, addi rN,rN,1 at +0xd4, cmpw cr0,rN,r0 at +0xe0). The web is created after the prologue stmw and dies before the epilogue lmw, so both builds save and restore identical caller values; the bisimulation confirms identity mapping still holds at the stmw (which fails closed on any non-identity saved register) and is re-established at the lmw.

Proven by replaying the finished patch through the real webfrank.apply_patch and asserting equality with the retail bytes (3 atoms/fields -> EQUALS-RETAIL). NOTE for future sessions: a self-contained bisimulation on the excerpt +0xa4..+0xe4 FAILS with 'differing word is unreachable from the function entry' because that range contains a forward branch leaving the excerpt; this is an artifact of excerpting, not of the rule, and the whole-function bisimulation passes. The shipped test therefore gathers the three real web words plus a blr, the same style already used for the msgDraw lineHeight web.
